name: Lemonade
description: Lemonade is an app-based insurer selling renters, homeowners, pet and car policies (plus a small share of policies placed with partner insurers for a commission) to about 3.3 million customers. Its bet is that software and automated claims handling cut costs, so it can win young first-time buyers and keep them as they add products (it says about 1.9 million of its customers already have car insurance elsewhere). It keeps the premium but hands a large share of it (a 'quota share') to reinsurers such as Hannover Re and MAPFRE in exchange for their taking that share of losses, which lowers the capital it must hold but also lowers the revenue it books. It still loses money, though the loss is shrinking: Q2 2026 net loss $43.4M on revenue of $294.4M.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not source-checked. SEC SIC code is 6331 (Fire, Marine & Casualty Insurance).

hq.note: EDGAR business address; large workforce in Israel and the Netherlands

employees.note: 1,282 employees, 810 in the US, the rest mainly Israel and the Netherlands (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Insurance (single reported segment)
businessLines.how: Customers pay annualized premium (average $433 per customer at 2026-06-30); Lemonade keeps the premium net of reinsurance, pays claims and expenses, earns interest on the float, and earns commissions on policies placed with partner insurers.
businessLines.description: 10-K: one segment; products are renters, homeowners, pet and car (direct to consumer), with about 4% of in-force premium being third-party-carrier policies Lemonade placed for commission. Segment split by product not extracted.

brands.name: Lemonade Car (incl. Metromile)
brands.note: Texas car policies use a fronting arrangement with a third-party carrier (assumed premium)

brands.name: Lemonade Pet
brands.note: About 87% of pet policies sold to new customers; about 5% of those have since added renters or home (10-K)
